title: I Tracked the Printmaking-Studio Fob Through Three Audits After They Cloned Mine

parts.text: I opened the printmaking studio at 6:04 p.m. and mentor Amos had already cloned my fob from the list. The board said: FOBS STAY WITH THE SLOT. GUEST PINS ARE NIGHTLY. I was thirty, studio secretary, holding a checkout that listed our numbered press. Amos shrugged. "Mentors are the press." I photographed the board, the clone list, and an unrecognized fob on the guest PIN. Then I asked for the fob log. At 6:12 the desk pinged a PIN from a number we did not know.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: An unrecognized fob just used the guest PIN toward the press stack.

social.video_title: They cloned my printmaking fob and used a guest PIN — Part 1/3
social.description: Printmaking studio, a clone list, a guest PIN on an unknown fob. Would you have asked for the fob log?

parts.text: Tuesday they were at the press cabinet with our numbered fobs. I printed Monday's PIN still and taped it to the board. Amos called it atmosphere. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. The board now has the still. At 6:18 the desk asked why the guest PIN opened the press stack two nights running. Amos said optics. Optics is a word mentors use when a fob exists.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: They are at the press cabinet; the board now has the still.

social.video_title: The guest PIN opened the press stack two nights — Part 2/3
social.description: Press cabinet, numbered fobs, a still on the board. Was atmosphere ever a fob?

parts.text: Thursday the board added a second line: MENTORS ARE NOT THE PRESS. Amos ran his own guest PIN and told the next mentor atmosphere was always about optics. I keep our fobs on a labeled hook. The clone is off the list. Amos brown-bags his PINs. The cabinet finally looks like a slot, not a clone. The rule looks ordinary now, which is the whole point.

social.video_title: Mentors are not the press — Part 3/3
social.description: Second line on the board, clone removed, guest PINs nightly. Was the press stack ever atmosphere?
